## The project

The Living SEB Project brings together cross-sectional studies of SEB skills in an open database that can be extended as new evidence appears. It is designed to support cumulative research and transparent, reproducible evidence synthesis [@feracoLivingSEBSkills2026].

The project focuses on skills as capacities, organized into five domains: innovation, self-management, social engagement, cooperation, and emotional resilience.

## How it works

The workflow combines systematic literature searches, coding of study characteristics and effect sizes, and reproducible analyses. An interactive app lets users explore studies, customize meta-analyses, and export results without writing R code.

Demonstration analyses examine associations with academic achievement and the incremental validity of SEB skills beyond personality traits. Because the database concerns cross-sectional studies, these associations should not be interpreted as evidence of causal effects or individual development over time.

## Living results

The [living results paper](https://feracotommaso.github.io/living_SEB_review/paper/livingSEBresults.html) presents the database and its synthesis. Consult that page for the results associated with the current release; the methodological publication describes the workflow.
